Population increased in Westmorland and Furness

The estimated population of Westmorland and Furness in 2024 was 230,185 usual residents, a rise of 0.7% since 2023.

This meant that Westmorland and Furness' rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Westmorland and Furness increased by 1.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Westmorland and Furness was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Westmorland and Furness

The average (median) age stayed at 49.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Westmorland and Furness has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Westmorland and Furness is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Westmorland and Furness' population of 230,185 usual residents was made up of:

  • 34,073 people aged 0 to 15 years, (14.8%)
  • 134,967 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.6%)
  • 61,145 people aged 65 years and over, (26.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Westmorland and Furness has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (26.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Westmorland and Furness, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Westmorland and Furness
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Westmorland and Furness, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,088 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 1,608 births and 2,696 deaths in Westmorland and Furness.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,529 (0.7%). There were 9,363 people entering the area and 7,834 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Westmorland and Furness' population of 1,040 (0.5%) as a result of 1,559 people entering the area and 519 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Westmorland and Furness was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Westmorland and Furness in mid-2023 is 228,646.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 583 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 124 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 459 people.
